title: ADVERSARIAL DÉJÀ VU: JAILBREAK DICTIONARY LEARNING FOR STRONGER GENERALIZATION TO UNSEEN ATTACKS
reasoning: The paper investigates and benchmarks how Large Language Models (LLMs) respond to jailbreak attacks designed to bypass safety and ethical guardrails. The evaluation includes prompts that specifically target religious hate speech and unethical behavior (e.g., non-consensual sexual pressure), measuring the models' compliance with safety and ethical standards using benchmarks like StrongReject.
